bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; n=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atqc "SELECT count(DISTINCT p.message_thread_id) FROM posting_topics p JOIN topic_dm_entry_pins t ON t.chat_id=p.chat_id AND t.message_thread_id=p.message_thread_id WHERE p.board_key='area_bbs' AND p.purpose='announcement' AND p.enabled=TRUE AND p.verified_at IS NOT NULL AND p.verified_by IS NOT NULL AND p.message_thread_id BETWEEN 49 AND 104 AND t.state='published' AND t.pinned=TRUE AND t.message_id IS NOT NULL" 2>/dev/null) || exit 201; test "$n" -le 100 || exit 202; exit $((100+n))
